Good morning,

Hope you're doing well - I've got a fun event coming up and I was thinking of hiring the Aldermoor Sprite. We're looking at the 30th July 2027 to pick it up at 12:30, and then we'll be bringing it back on Monday 2 August 2027 at 17:30. We'll be collecting it from your garage. I've attached my driving licence for your records. 

Cheers,
Victor Braithwell
